description:
Search notes and logs and summarise thread activity. Returns pointers (absolute paths plus metadata), never file bodies.

Subcommands:
  notes [--thread T] [--type TYPE] [--text S] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find notes
  logs [--thread T] [--text S] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — find daily logs
  activity [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — rank threads by activity in a window (notes, logs and hours)
  overview THREAD [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — everything about one thread
  stream [--thread T] [--kind K] [--text S] [--today] [--reverse] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--limit N] [--json] — every dated record merged into one chronology

Args:
  THREAD / T   thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  DATE         YYYY-MM-DD. --since and --until are inclusive.

Flags:
  all subcommands:
    --since DATE / --until DATE   date window, inclusive
    --json                        JSON output
  notes:
    --type TYPE   note type, e.g. Meeting; case-insensitive
    --text S      case-insensitive literal, matched against topic and body
    --limit N     max results (default 20; 0 = all)
  logs:
    --text S      case-insensitive literal, matched against entry lines
    --limit N     max results (default 20; 0 = all)
  activity:
    --thread T    limit to one thread
  overview:
    --limit N     recent items to list (default 5; 0 = all)
  stream:
    --kind K      comma-separated list from: note, log, task, done, hours, payment, thread, person, pending (default: all)
    --text S      case-insensitive literal, matched against thread and summary
    --today       today only; same as --since today --until today
    --reverse     oldest first (default: newest first)
    --limit N     max events (default 100; 0 = all)

Examples:
  ["notes", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--type", "Meeting", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["logs", "--text", "invoice", "--limit", "0"]
  ["overview", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["stream", "--today", "--kind", "note,task,hours"]

Notes:
  Read-only. To read a result, pass its stem to `notes cat`, or open the absolute path.
  Dates are event dates: a note's frontmatter timestamp, not its filename.
  Hours entry descriptions are not searched by --text.
  Exit 1: unknown --kind value.
